rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0001
rows.name:
You can teach such vicious monsters a
lesson? Drivers are amazing, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0002
rows.name:
As thanks, I'll teach you Drivers a
secret technique for battle, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0003
rows.name:
When an enemy is knocked down in
battle, if you use a technique that
launches it...

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Then—popooon! You can launch that
enemy into the air, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0005
rows.name:
It's really exhilarating, so try it
next time, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000064_01_msg0006
rows.name:
...or so it said in a book I picked
up the other day, mo.
